landscape.name: Retail Core Banking & Transactional Rails (BIAN Architecture)
landscape.description: Squad Cuentas & Rieles Transaccionales: 11 BIAN Service Domains, 80 Repositories, 20 Flows on AWS

systems.name: SD-01: CURRENT ACCOUNT
systems.description: Fulfills standard current account servicing, balances, transactions, deposits, and debit management.

systems.name: SD-02: PAYMENT EXECUTION
systems.description: Orchestrates outbound and inbound funds transfers, domestic clearing (CCE), instant P2P transfers, and rails routing.

systems.name: SD-03: PARTY ROUTING PROFILE
systems.description: Maintains customer identity aliases, phone/email-to-account mappings for instant P2P payments (e.g. Yape/Plin), and channel profiles.

systems.name: SD-04: CUSTOMER OFFER & ONBOARDING
systems.description: Manages customer digital acquisition, biometric KYC verification, pre-approved credit lines, and account origination.

systems.name: SD-05: CUSTOMER AGREEMENT & CONTRACT
systems.description: Maintains contractual terms, digital signatures, legal disclosures, fees agreements, and product conditions.

systems.name: SD-06: POSITION KEEPING & BALANCES
systems.description: Maintains real-time authorized, ledger, available, and hold balances with microsecond latency.

systems.name: SD-07: FINANCIAL ACCOUNTING & GENERAL LEDGER
systems.description: Generates double-entry accounting bookings, chart of accounts journal vouchers, and end-of-day reconciliation balances.

systems.name: SD-08: COLLATERAL ALLOCATION & GUARANTEES
systems.description: Monitors collateralized guarantees, lien holds, escrow reserves, and asset-backed credit ceilings.

systems.name: SD-09: FRAUD DETECTION & RISK SCORING
systems.description: Evaluates transactional risk in real time (<50ms), flags anomaly patterns, calculates device risk scores, and triggers security lockouts.

systems.name: SD-10: CUSTOMER ALERT & NOTIFICATION
systems.description: Multi-channel transactional alert dispatch (Push notifications, SMS, Email, WhatsApp) with preference routing and delivery tracking.

systems.name: SD-11: AUDIT, LOGGING & REGULATORY COMPLIANCE
systems.description: Immutable audit trails, AML (Anti-Money Laundering) transaction tracking, regulatory reporting (SBS/UIF), and compliance alarms.

flows.name: Direct Digital Account Opening & KYC
flows.description: Prospect initiates digital onboarding, completes facial biometrics, signs contract, and receives opened active account.

steps.action: Trigger onboarding state machine
Validate facial biometric with RENIEC
Register digital terms and legal agreement
Create and activate Current Account in master table
AccountOpenedEvent.v1 emitted and projected
Dispatch welcome SMS/Push notification

flows.name: Outbound Instant P2P Transfer (Yape/Plin)
flows.description: User enters mobile phone number, resolves destination CCI, places authorization hold, routes via instant rails, and clears funds.

steps.action: Resolve recipient phone number to destination bank and CCI
Calculate real-time transactional fraud score
Orchestrate multi-step transfer transaction
Place hold on source account balance
Dispatch funds over instant clearing rail (CCE/BCRP)
Commit balance debit and clear hold
Notify sender and recipient via Push & SMS

flows.name: Inbound Clearing Payment (CCE / ACH)
flows.description: Receives inbound interbank payment batch, validates destination account, credits ledger, and acknowledges clearinghouse.

steps.action: InboundPaymentReceivedEvent.v1 dispatched
Verify account status is ACTIVE
Post credit deposit to account
BalanceCommittedEvent.v1 emitted to update balance
Post accounting ledger entry

flows.name: Debit Card Transaction Authorization Hold
flows.description: POS or e-commerce terminal attempts card swipe; checks balance, runs fraud filter, and holds funds.

steps.action: Real-time risk scoring (<35ms)
Request authorization hold on available funds
Verify available balance >= hold amount
Return ISO 8583 Authorization Approved (00)

flows.name: Hold Settlement & Financial Clearing
flows.description: Merchant batch presents settled transactions, releasing prior holds and committing final debits.

steps.action: Release reservation hold
Apply final financial debit to master account
Post double-entry journal voucher to general ledger

flows.name: Real-Time Balance & Mini-Statement Inquiry
flows.description: Mobile app or ATM requests customer balances and last 10 movements with sub-20ms P99 latency.

steps.action: Read cached available & ledger balance from Redis/DAX
Fetch latest 10 movements with pagination token

flows.name: Scheduled Direct Debit Service Billing
flows.description: Executes recurring utility or subscription bill payment against user current account.

steps.action: Validate account active and direct debit authorized
Execute debit order against biller CCI
Record transaction fee and settlement

flows.name: Overdraft Line Auto-Trigger & Coverage
flows.description: When customer balance is insufficient for critical payment, checks credit line and triggers overdraft loan.

steps.action: Account balance insufficient - request overdraft ceiling check
Check pledged collateral or pre-approved limit
Disburse overdraft funds into account to cover debit

flows.name: Real-Time Transaction Fraud Evaluation (<50ms)
flows.description: Inline synchronous inspection of payment parameters against machine learning fraud model and device intelligence.

steps.action: Query device IP reputation, geo-velocity, emulator flags
Query behavioral biometric score (typing cadence, gyros)
Check customer historical fraud index and blacklist

flows.name: High-Risk Account Preventative Freeze
flows.description: When confirmed compromise or brute-force pattern is detected, immediately locks account and alerts security squad.

steps.action: Set account state to 'SECURITY_FROZEN'
Dispatch emergency SMS/Email security notice to customer
Record security event in CloudWatch security metric filter

flows.name: Customer Contact Preference & Alias Update
flows.description: Customer updates mobile phone number or changes primary account linked to instant P2P payments.

steps.action: Update directory record mapping phone to new CCI
Broadcast alias update to national directory federation
Record alias change audit trail

flows.name: Daily Interest Accrual Calculation
flows.description: Calculates daily earned interest on positive savings account balances and schedules monthly payout.

steps.action: Fetch daily average cleared balance
Accrue daily interest into liability ledger

flows.name: End-of-Day (EOD) Ledger Reconciliation
flows.description: Midnight batch locks daily transactions, compares cloud ledger balances against host mainframe, and produces delta reports.

steps.action: Freeze daily balance snapshot across all accounts
Pull Host DB2 daily total ledger report
Trigger P0 Alarm if Cloud vs Host balance delta != 0.00

flows.name: General Ledger Journal Accounting Posting
flows.description: Transforms settled retail transactions into standardized accounting vouchers for ERP ingestion.

steps.action: Aggregate transaction types into ledger accounts
Transmit posted journal vouchers into SAP S/4HANA

flows.name: Multi-Channel Transaction Alert Notification
flows.description: Subscribes to transaction completed events and dispatches notifications based on customer opted-in channels.

steps.action: Dispatch instant mobile app push alert
Send SMS confirmation if push is undelivered or for high amounts
Record notification proof and delivery timestamp

flows.name: Account Maintenance Fee Assessment
flows.description: Monthly recurring job checks average balance; applies maintenance commission fee if minimum balance is not met.

steps.action: Evaluate average balance against fee waiver rule
Initiate automated maintenance fee deduction order
Record bank fee revenue accounting entry

flows.name: Digital Terms & Conditions Legal Consent
flows.description: Captures customer acceptance of updated product terms, biometric data consent, and regulatory disclosures.

steps.action: Apply legal cryptographic timestamp and certificate seal
Index accepted clauses into contract repository
Store legal proof in WORM immutable storage

flows.name: Mainframe Host Realtime & Batch Sync
flows.description: Provides backward compatibility for branch tellers, ATMs, and legacy systems during gradual core migration.

steps.action: Forward cloud account modifications to Host SNA queue
Receive teller cash branch deposits from Host CICS

flows.name: Regulatory AML & UIF Suspicious Report
flows.description: Identifies suspicious transaction patterns (smurfing, sudden large transfers >$10k) and generates regulatory reporting files.

steps.action: Aggregate single and multi-party transactions exceeding threshold
Format encrypted RO/UIF XML compliance submission file

flows.name: Distributed Transfer Saga Compensation
flows.description: Automated backward rollback when instant transfer times out or target bank rejects funds after source hold was created.

steps.action: Receive 504 Gateway Timeout or Reject response
Cancel and unfreeze source account balance reservation
Increment transaction compensation counter in CloudWatch
Notify user that transfer failed and funds remain available
